integrity: The proof is an exact all-\(n\) argument from the published double-binomial formula using a summand involution, Lucas parity, and Kummer carries. The recent source supplies the coefficient formula but not the mod-\(8\) conclusion.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the dichotomy \(\nu_2(c_{11}(n))=2\) versus \(\nu_2(c_{11}(n))\ge3\); it does not determine higher valuations or higher-power congruences. The finite checker is corroborative only.
title: A mod-\(8\) classification for the level-\(11\) Ramanujan–Sato coefficients
